08-companion-operating.nodeContent:
{
  "id": "08-companion-operating",
  "contract": {
    "intent": "Make the companion operating guide ann's living contract: keep it durable (committed, locked artifact) and make it a goal leg in ann's own journey, so the look-back can check how ann is doing against its promises.",
    "acceptanceCriteria": [
      "Guide kept: the companion guide is a committed, locked artifact in this leg (real file under the leg's artifacts/, type record, sha recorded) — re-locked as a new version whenever it changes",
      "Gaps tracked: every §3 gap in the guide maps to a task in this journey (open or done) — no gap is silent; the mapping is visible in the journey",
      "Log-protectors landed: terminal freeze, gate rationale, and native correction flow each complete as a done task under this leg, with check + verify staying clean as evidence",
      "Look-back works: ann journey 08-companion-operating + check + verify report ann's fitness — green, or naming exactly what is off — so a periodic review can check how ann is doing directly from the journey",
      "Dogfooding holds: this leg is managed through ann (spawned, gated, locked via CLI; no hand-edited events), with rationale recorded at its gates"
    ],
    "targetAreas": [
      ".agents/artifacts/ann-companion-guide.html",
      ".ann/journey/legs/08-companion-operating"
    ],
    "requiredInputs": [],
    "expectedOutputs": [
      "locked companion-guide artifact",
      "gap-to-task mapping",
      "log-protector tasks (terminal freeze, gate rationale, correction flow)",
      "fitness look-back read (journey / check / verify)"
    ]
  },
  "createdAt": "2026-09-01"
}

08-companion-operating/02-implementation.nodeContent:
{
  "id": "08-companion-operating/02-implementation-write-confinement",
  "contract": {
    "intent": "Constrain ann's writers in CODE so an out-of-folder write is unrepresentable: every write path derives from the addressed node's canonical folder (a store node handle), never from a caller-supplied path. lock! and supersede! lose their free path arguments. The AGENTS.md rule is convention only — this makes it structural.",
    "acceptanceCriteria": [
      "Node handle: store.resolveNode(id) is the only id→folder mapping — it returns an opaque NodeDir (canonical folder under .ann/journey/legs) and refuses anything not under the store's legs root",
      "Writers take the handle: appendEvent(node, …) and every task write derive their file path as join(node.dir, <fixed relative>); no caller passes or re-derives a path string",
      "lock! drops the free path: it takes the handle + an artifact-relative name, resolves it inside the node's own artifacts/ dir, and refuses a file outside that folder",
      "supersede! names its successor by node id + artifact name (resolved via resolveNode), not a raw path — remaining the one sanctioned cross-node writer",
      "Proven green: existing suite passes, ann check stays at the accepted baseline (no new findings), and a test demonstrates an out-of-folder write target is refused/unrepresentable"
    ],
    "targetAreas": [
      "src/store",
      "src/commands"
    ],
    "requiredInputs": [],
    "expectedOutputs": [
      "refactored store/commands writer API (NodeDir handle-based)",
      "lock! and supersede! with no free path argument",
      "test proving out-of-folder writes are unrepresentable"
    ]
  },
  "createdAt": "2026-09-02"
}

09-shaping.nodeContent:
{
  "id": "09-shaping",
  "contract": {
    "intent": "Make the shaping phase a real, proportionate product: the phase that turns an idea into a validated, grounded plan is named and built out as shaping. Depth is decided by the grill (small clear ideas skip the vision), and the interactive session gathers enough with a paced, human experience. This leg turns the decided shaping model into working flow + tests and documents the phase so the look-back reads it as part of how ann operates.",
    "acceptanceCriteria": [
      "Shaping is the name of the idea-to-plan phase wherever the flow is described; spec names only the final document",
      "Depth is conditional: the grill decides whether the vision runs; a small/clear solid idea reaches a light spec without a vision (tested)",
      "The full path still exists for ambiguous ideas: vision then spec (tested)",
      "The grill session gathers the depth signal and open questions in a bounded, batched dialogue; the human never re-authors a prior artifact",
      "ann check and verify hold at the accepted baselines and the leg is managed through ann with rationale at its gates"
    ],
    "targetAreas": [
      "rules/flow",
      "src/flow",
      "companion guide / generated docs"
    ],
    "requiredInputs": [],
    "expectedOutputs": [
      "conditional shaping chain (vision optional by grill)",
      "shaping naming reconciled across flow data + docs",
      "proportionate grill-depth interaction",
      "tests + evidence + committed leg"
    ]
  },
  "createdAt": "2026-09-04"
}

09-shaping/01-shaping-flow.nodeContent:
{
  "id": "09-shaping/01-shaping-flow",
  "contract": {
    "intent": "Make the shaping phase concrete in the flow: name the idea-to-plan phase shaping (spec remains the name of the final document only), and make depth conditional on the grill so a solid small/clear idea runs straight to a light spec without a vision step, while a full vision still runs for genuinely ambiguous ideas.",
    "acceptanceCriteria": [
      "Naming: the definition side of the flow is called shaping in the chain template, generated docs, and companion guide; nothing calls the whole phase specs; the final document is still called spec",
      "Depth routing: a solid low-ambiguity idea runs without a vision step (test: no vision artifact is produced for that case)",
      "Full path preserved: an ambiguous idea still produces vision then spec (test)",
      "Proportionate interaction: the grill gathers the depth signal and any open questions in a bounded batched session; the human never re-authors a prior artifact",
      "Proven green: suite passes; check and verify hold at the accepted baselines; the conditional path is expressed in the flow chain data, not hard-coded per step"
    ],
    "targetAreas": [
      "rules/flow/default.json",
      "src/flow/steps",
      "companion guide"
    ],
    "requiredInputs": [],
    "expectedOutputs": [
      "conditional chain (vision optional by grill verdict)",
      "shaping naming reconciled",
      "tests for both depth paths"
    ]
  },
  "createdAt": "2026-09-04"
}

10-goal-record/01-implementation-goal-se.nodeContent:
{
  "id": "10-goal-record/01-implementation-goal-session-record",
  "contract": {
    "intent": "Author and record the two superseding amendments that form the recorded half of the landed goal-session feature: journey-format-spec v17 (a complete superseding artifact capturing the goal-leg root carve-out, the goal-met eventType, the done-without-tasks derivation, goal.md doc-SSOT with generated node.json, and goal! met|archive plus the archive layout) and resource-registry v4 (a complete superseding artifact with two new reconciliation rows in its register: goal-met plus its validateEventShape literal, and the goal-leg root-events carve-out in appendEvent). Supersede the v16 and v3 producers, lock the new artifacts, record evidence, and finish AGENTS.md as the re-pointed referrer.",
    "acceptanceCriteria": [
      "journey-format-spec v17 is a COMPLETE superseding artifact reusing the logical name journey-format-spec and preserving section anchors, capturing the recorded goal-session amendment: the designated childless goal leg is the single leg-root exception to the no-events rule, carrying only the seed (created+completed, written by seedGoal never the general writer), the goal.md lock, and goal-met; goal-met is the new eventType (shape, status-inert, guarded human-only); the seeded goal leg derives done without tasks so the first work leg legGateMet opens; goal.md is the doc source of truth and node.json is generated 1:1 from its Goal and Success criteria sections; goal! met and goal! archive with the archive layout",
      "resource-registry v4 is a COMPLETE superseding artifact reusing the logical name resource-registry and preserving section anchors, its register gaining two rows phrased like the existing ones: goal-met with the store validateEventShape literal, and the goal-leg root-events carve-out with the appendEvent literal (goalLegId, goalRootEvent)",
      "superseded events on the v16 journey-format-spec producer and the v3 resource-registry producer each carry a successor forward pointer; current(journey-format-spec) is the v17 producer and current(resource-registry) is the v4 producer after lock",
      "AGENTS.md is accurate and re-pointed: the hot invariants already name the goal-leg exception and goal! archive from the feature commit (no duplication), and the deeper-docs rows for journey-format-spec and resource-registry cite the current v17 and v4 producers",
      "Evidence recorded with real commit shas; both gates accepted with rationale; check and verify hold at the accepted baselines with only the intended supersede and lock deltas accounted for"
    ],
    "requiredInputs": [
      "journey-format-spec",
      "resource-registry"
    ],
    "expectedOutputs": [
      "journey-format-spec v17 (superseding v16)",
      "resource-registry v4 (superseding v3)",
      "AGENTS.md re-pointed"
    ],
    "targetAreas": [
      ".ann/journey/legs/10-goal-record/01-implementation-goal-session-record/artifacts",
      "AGENTS.md"
    ],
    "workType": "implementation"
  },
  "createdAt": "2026-09-05"
}
